name: YOOPAI PLA+ @Creality Ender-3 Pro
filament_notes:
YOOPAI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C for 8 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 12 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
yoopai.com product page (sold as 'INGEO PLA Plus Filament', made with NatureWorks Ingeo PLA): print speed under 300 mm/s, nozzle 190-230C, bed 35-65C; 1.75 +/-0.03 mm. Drying 50C 8h is NOT on the 1kg page; it comes from YOOPAI's lineup comparison chart image (PLA+ row: 190-230C, <300 mm/s, 50C 8h), which appears on the yoopai.com 250g bundle pages and on the Amazon 250g PLA+ bundle listings. The 250g 'PLA+ Starter Color Bundle' (4 or 8 rolls) and 'PLA Filament Bundle for Bambu Lab, 250g x 8' are the same PLA+ on 250g spools (135 mm OD, 53 mm hub); their text gives no settings. No 1kg non-matte PLA+ listing was found on Amazon under the YOOPAI name. Legacy Amazon 1kg listings titled 'YOOPAI PLA ... PLA+ Filament' (Sakura Pink B0FLY36P32, Yellow, Milk White) sit in the Silk PLA variation family and carry Silk PLA bullets and images (190-215C, 30-60C bed, 50-80 mm/s); treated as a listing error and not used. Fan, density not published.
Source: https://www.yoopai.com/products/ingeo-pla-plus-filament-1-75mm-us-sourced-pla-1kg-2-2lbs
